findings.message: S600 is the speed in force when the tapping block on line 9 (G84.2) runs. A tap's feed follows from its speed and its pitch, so the speed is left as written: scaled on its own it would break the tap. Change the speed and the feed together by hand if the tap should run at another speed.

S400 is the speed in force when the tapping block on line 16 (G63) runs. A tap's feed follows from its speed and its pitch, so the speed is left as written: scaled on its own it would break the tap. Change the speed and the feed together by hand if the tap should run at another speed.
S500 is an argument or a data value of G65, not a spindle speed of this program, so it is left as written.
